title: EDGE: DBMS-Empowered Boolean Decomposition for GIG Synthesis
problem: Boolean decomposition-based logic synthesis is high-quality but computationally expensive, limiting application to large and complex logic functions in modern circuit design.
motivation: Decomposition-based synthesis yields superior results when combined with small-window optimization, but computational bottlenecks prevent scaling to industrial-scale gate-inverter graphs (GIGs).
method: EDGE leverages modern database (DBMS) techniques to accelerate Boolean decomposition queries and candidate enumeration. Database queries replace iterative decomposition searches, exploiting relational query optimization to speedup candidate generation and evaluation for Gate-Inverter Graph synthesis.
key_novelty: Application of DBMS query optimization to accelerate Boolean decomposition candidate exploration in logic synthesis.
contributions: Database-driven acceleration of Boolean decomposition achieving 21x runtime speedup
15% reduction in node count over state-of-the-art synthesis methods
DBMS framework enabling scalable decomposition for large/complex logic
limitations: Focus on GIG-based synthesis; applicability to other logic representations or synthesis flows not discussed.
primary_theme: Database acceleration for Boolean decomposition synthesis
